exposure: Ultrasonographic screening criteria at 11-14 weeks of gestation
cohort: Pregnant mothers with a history of cesarean section, referred for routine ultrasonographic screening at 11-14 weeks of gestation.
finding: Ultrasonographic screening identified only one case of placenta accreta in the high-risk group, and no relationship was found between placenta accreta and disease risk, placenta previa, cesarean section, maternal age, or gravidity, yet the study concluded that screening can identify high-risk individuals.
followup_time: From 11-14 weeks of gestation until delivery
gest_age: Enrollment at 11-14 weeks of gestation; one case delivered at 35 weeks of gestation.
